resources.string: Blocks keys and touches while the proximity sensor is covered

PocketGuard swallows keypad presses and touches while the proximity sensor reports an object nearby (phone in pocket) and the display is on. It does not read screen content. Needed so it can intercept hardware keys.
Press these keys in order while input is blocked to disable the keyguard (2 s max between presses). Allowed keys: 0-9 * # CALL BACK MENU UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT OK VOLUP VOLDOWN
Lock delay must be a whole number of seconds
Escape sequence must have at least 4 valid keys
